DML.SELECT: SELECT ext_entity_type_id as "extEntityTypeId", ext_entity_type_param_id as "extEntityTypeParamId", ext_entity_id as "extEntityId", value as "value", enabled as "enabled", visible as "visible", created_at as "createdAt", updated_at as "updatedAt" FROM rt.ext_entity_values WHERE enabled = true or enabled is null
DML.INSERT: INSERT INTO rt.ext_entity_values (ext_entity_type_id, ext_entity_type_param_id, ext_entity_id, value, enabled, visible, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (:extEntityTypeId, :extEntityTypeParamId, :extEntityId, :value, :enabled, :visible, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
DML.UPDATE: UPDATE rt.ext_entity_values SET value = :value, enabled = :enabled, visible = :visible, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE ext_entity_type_id = :extEntityTypeId AND ext_entity_type_param_id = :extEntityTypeParamId AND ext_entity_id = :extEntityId
DML.DELETE: DELETE FROM rt.ext_entity_values WHERE ext_entity_type_id = :extEntityTypeId AND ext_entity_type_param_id = :extEntityTypeParamId AND ext_entity_id = :extEntityId
